repairs: One owned status socket serves HTTP1/HTTP2 and generated TiKV unary, streaming and batch commands in both startup paths.
Incoming KILL uses the local process registry with live configuration and never redispatches.
Incoming CLUSTER_PROCESSLIST shares session visibility/formatting, identity/default-role authorization, table IDs and both existing encoders.
Column IDs and output offsets are validated; unsupported tables/operators and malformed protobuf produce OtherError.
Cluster TLS follows Go no-client-cert default and required verified leaf-CN allowlist policy; HTTP and gRPC share ALPN.
Joined shutdown aborts connections and unfinished handshakes and releases listener/route owners. HTTP half-close preserves complete requests.
Decode all supported nested batch commands before effects; malformed later input cannot execute an earlier KILL.
cleanup: Removed http_request.rs (145 lines including private framing test); meaningful fragmentation/chunking/error cases migrated to the actual HTTP transport.
Removed detached status accept/request threads and manual HTTP response framing.
Removed unused Axum serving features; preserved selected dependency versions.
Reconciled stale current counts and inbound-hosting descriptions across both registers and batch maps.

diagnosed_intermediate_failures.cause: Disk exhausted before baseline execution; then linker lacked space. Completed generated executables were retired with hashes; final baseline executed and failed both assertions.
The first HTTP test detected hyper default half-close behavior; shared transport now enables half_close and the same test passes.
External Python probe used Rust conn_id spelling rather than descriptor connID; fixed probe; no product code change.

limits: No complete pkg/server/pkg/executor package acceptance, platform/generated/test inventory acceptance, live Go server, multi-node TiKV or performance claim.
Other cluster memory tables and pushed operators, full coprocessor memory accounting, AutoID/other RPC service hosting and shutdown health signaling remain unresolved.
Both production startup paths compile; live SQL validation uses unistore.
Other carried findings were not freshly re-audited.

publication.required: Actual hooks/pre-commit locked server build, followed by a fresh locked build immediately before normal push and exact remote SHA verification; recorded in external final-handoff.json
